limitations.legacy_state_identity_statement: The inspected rollout schema exposed no stable provider request ID. The prescribed deterministic legacy-state fallback counted changed per-turn usage states and suppressed consecutive unchanged echoes; it cannot distinguish genuinely separate requests with identical usage state.
